archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-10.6 Monitor Impact and Satisfaction
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Engagement does not end when data is delivered — it continues through impact assessment and evaluation. This step measures how statistical data and services are being used, what decisions they inform, and how satisfied users are with their experience. Metrics include website usage, downloads, citations, customer satisfaction surveys, and social media reach. Qualitative evaluations assess how well data supports evidence-based policy and societal understanding. Results are shared internally to guide continuous improvement across all value streams. By closing the loop, the organization ensures that stakeholder engagement remains evidence-driven and outcome-focused.
Value created: Clear insight into how statistics create societal value and how stakeholder relationships can be further strengthened.
